comparison.objective: Serve chopsticks lying on their rest and never upright in rice.
comparison.physical_skill: Slender-object grasping and precise placement, not key insertion, fastener manipulation, or iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Chopsticks must rest in the culturally appropriate pose; numeric pose tolerances and explicit failure boundaries are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared fine placement is generic; the tested ability is culturally constrained utensil placement.
